mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo ( id, marker_id, object_key, status, attached_at, content_type, size_bytes, width, height, checksum_sha256, upload_url_expires_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{markerId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{objectKey}, #{status}, #{attachedAt}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{width}, #{height}, #{checksumSha256}, #{uploadUrlExpiresAt}, #{version}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, attached_at = EXCLUDED.attached_at, width = EXCLUDED.width, height = EXCLUDED.height, version = EXCLUDED.version, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, marker_id, object_key, status, attached_at, content_type, size_bytes, width, height, checksum_sha256, upload_url_expires_at, version FROM photo WHERE id = #{photoId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
